gate_reasoning: Stage 6 scores 64% Low confidence across 47 scored claims, placing it in the 30-70% Low band (ship-with-flag). The High-confidence cluster is structurally sound: IUMI primary-association figures (with the caveat of unverified PDF), TT Club annual report, Verisk CargoNet incident database, Tokio Marine Holdings annual report, FMCSA primary-gov source, and ReCAAP ISC piracy data. The Low-confidence concentration falls overwhelmingly in two problem areas: (1) all insurtech startup funding and valuation claims (Loadsure, Parsyl, Breeze, Cover Genius, Nirvana) are sourced from vendor press releases or secondary news with no Form D or audited filing — this is structurally the weakest part of the document and is also the section most likely to receive investor scrutiny in a venture pitch; (2) all vendor-self-reported capability metrics (Overhaul recovery rates, Parsyl IoT claim reduction, Loadsure claims speed, Nirvana telematics discount) trigger the vendor-marketing auto-Low override and cannot be promoted without independent third-party corroboration. The five priority attended-fetch actions (IUMI PDF, Nirvana Form D, TT Club/BSI piracy PDF, CargoNet recovery rate search, and FMCSA jury award primary source) would materially improve the document's evidentiary foundation for the venture pitch. The stage should not be presented to Tokio Marine or ID&E in current form without those five actions completed.
